title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Cases of Administrative Application for Retrial

articles.content_en: Article 1 Where a party refuses to accept a legally effective judgment or ruling of a Higher People's Court and applies to the Supreme People's Court for a retrial in accordance with Article 90 of the Administrative Procedure Law, the Supreme People's Court shall examine according to law and handle the case according to the circumstances.

Article 4 Where a legally effective judgment or ruling finds the facts clearly, applies laws and regulations correctly, and the retrial grounds asserted by the party are not established, the Supreme People's Court may directly render a ruling to dismiss the application for retrial.

Article 5 Where a party refuses to accept the judgment or ruling of a People's Court upon retrial, it may apply to the People's Procuratorate for a protest or procuratorial recommendation according to law.

Article 6 This Interpretation shall come into force on April 1, 2021. After this Interpretation comes into force, if any relevant judicial interpretation previously made by the Supreme People's Court conflicts with this Interpretation, this Interpretation shall prevail.
Annex 1: Decision of the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China (for use when the Supreme People's Court decides that a Higher People's Court shall examine)
Annex 2: Notice of the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China (for use when the Supreme People's Court notifies the applicant for retrial of its decision that a Higher People's Court shall examine)
Annex 3: Administrative Ruling of the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China (for use when the Supreme People's Court directly dismisses an application for retrial)

Annex 2
Notice of the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China
(××××) Zui Gao Fa Xing Tong No. ×
××× (applicant for retrial):

Please await the result of examination. If you still refuse to accept the judgment or ruling made by the Higher People's Court after examination, you may apply to the People's Procuratorate for a protest or procuratorial recommendation in accordance with Article 117 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.
We hereby notify you.
